title: SUPERHOT OFF EACH SITTING
why: his order of 10-27: superhot mode should be off by default; his save has carried it on since 10-25, so the game opened with it on and the party would have too
now: every sitting starts with superhot off: the settings row and the key left of 1 still turn it on for that sitting, the next load is off again, and the 2 player demo starts with it off

edits.replacement:
if(sb.tuned) delete sb.tuned.flashRed;
  sb.gameOpts.superhot=0; if(sb.tuned) delete sb.tuned.superhot;   // v35.xx (cw-shoff), his order of 10-27 "superhot mode should be off by default": the demo starts with it off too

edits.anchor: CFG.flashRed=1; // v28.xx (cw-cx-flashdefault): the demo setting takes effect in either window at entry.
edits.replacement:
CFG.flashRed=1; // v28.xx (cw-cx-flashdefault): the demo setting takes effect in either window at entry.
  if(netShHost()===null) CFG.superhot=0;   // v35.xx (cw-shoff): the demo starts with Superhot off; on a linked window the host word still decides (v16.74). Leaving puts the sitting dial back.
